open_points.subject: flow:start_and_recover_kernel / step 3 (bindings.check_installed_instances)
open_points.text: State 4 says: "capability:bindings.check_installed_instances: no credential header has, case-insensitively, the name of a required header of its instance (A09 rule 1)." But State 2 A09 rule 1 also requires start refusal when the credential header matches "a header the kernel sets itself ... `host` included".
open_points.question: At startup, must instance checking reject only credential-header vs required-header collisions, or also credential-header collisions with kernel-set headers (`host`, `accept-encoding`, `content-type`, `content-length`)?
options: Reject only collisions with required headers
Reject collisions with required headers and with kernel-set headers (as A09 rule 1 states)
open_points.default_guess: Reject both kinds of collisions, following A09 rule 1 as the stricter normative source.
